column1: # SPI_PS_INPUT_ENA of the corpus pixel shaders whose input VGPRs are not persp_center alone (tools/corpus_translate.py
# reads it; docs/design/pixel-bindings.md, "Input VGPRs"). The dumps do not print the register, so it is reconstructed:
# ACO enables persp_center for the v_interp barycentrics (and, as the hardware needs one barycentric input, for a
# program that interpolates nothing), pos_x..pos_w for each gl_FragCoord component the program reads as a float,
# pos_fixed_pt for ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy) (an integer pixel coordinate), front_face for gl_FrontFacing and ancillary
# for gl_ShadingRateEXT; SPI_PS_INPUT_ADDR equals ENA. The builtins are read off each shader's GLSL source at the
# commit tests/corpus/README.md names; the dump confirms the layout (an a16 image address reads pos_fixed_pt, the
# depth comparisons read pos_z, a z / gl_FragCoord.w is a product with pos_w). Every other corpus shader is lowered
# with 0x2, persp_center alone: its program reads no input VGPR past v1.
# Columns: shader, SPI_PS_INPUT_ENA, enabled inputs in VGPR order, the GLSL builtins they come from.
